svg.title: Beckmann rearrangement: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Cyclic imidic acid + acid/base proton relays → Ring C(=O)–NH–(CH2)5–(back). Proton transfers and pi-bond reorganization yield caprolactam. No uncatalyzed1,3-H migration is inserted.
